metadata.title: Incident Response SSPP
metadata.remarks: This SSPP defines how confirmed threat detections are acted upon through coordinated containment, eradication, recovery, and escalation, under explicit authority and workflow constraints.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits authority, workflow, escalation, and detection requirements and SHALL NOT redefine decision ownership.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines permissible response actions, severity handling, containment scope, recovery requirements, and escalation rules once malicious activity is confirmed.

system-implementation.remarks: Incident Response activities SHALL be coordinated, attributable, and reversible where possible. Response SHALL not compromise evidence integrity or bypass governance escalation.

incident-severity-levels.description: Confirmed malicious activity with limited scope and negligible business impact.
Confirmed malicious activity with measurable impact or risk of propagation.
Confirmed malicious activity causing significant business, regulatory, or safety impact.

response-actions.statement: Response MAY include containment actions such as isolation, access revocation, or process termination.
Response MAY include eradication of adversary artifacts once containment is confirmed.
Response SHALL include recovery actions to restore systems to a trusted state.

response-constraints.statement: All response actions SHALL be executed under the authority defined in the Security Operations Authority SSPP.
Response actions SHALL preserve evidence when forensic escalation is reasonably anticipated.
Response scope SHALL be proportional to confirmed impact and severity.

mandatory-escalation.statement: Incidents involving data loss, regulatory impact, insider activity, or repeated exploitation SHALL escalate to Digital Forensics.
High-severity incidents and systemic failures SHALL escalate beyond Security Operations.

control-implementation.description: Controls ensure coordinated, accountable, and governed incident handling.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Incidents are handled according to defined procedures and severity.
Incident monitoring supports awareness of response effectiveness.
Incident response activities are documented and reported.
Incident response is integrated with organizational recovery and governance.

statements.statement: Incident Response SHALL NOT be initiated without a confirmed detection.
Automation SHALL NOT initiate or expand response actions without explicit authorization.
Incident Response SHALL NOT override forensic holds or chain-of-custody requirements.
Incident Response SHALL NOT formally accept risk or close architectural violations.

back-matter.remarks: Downstream SSPPs for SOAR and Digital Forensics SHALL respect response boundaries and escalation requirements defined in this SSPP.
